explorations: Use case: logo-brand. Create one polished square brand identity concept board for the exact brand name "KINGAI" (K I N G A I), an AI-powered open-source project discovery and ranking product. Refined commercial software identity, clean vector-like flat shapes, extremely crisp edges, optically balanced custom typography, generous negative space. Warm ivory #FAF8F4 overall background, near-black #242621 lettering, burnt orange #EF6938 accent, restrained palette suitable for an ivory/orange SaaS website. Main hero of the board: large symbol plus horizontal KINGAI wordmark. Bottom quarter: neat three compact applications showing the same identity as a small favicon, monochrome mark, and reversed white/orange lockup on a charcoal rectangle. These must all faithfully match the main mark. No photographic mockups, no gradients, no 3D, no shadows, no generic AI brain, no circuit boards, no chatbot face, no resemblance to existing famous AI company logos. Only display the text KINGAI and the small variant number; no other slogans or paragraphs. This is an original identity exploration, not a website screenshot. Variant number "01". Direction: a distinctive geometric K monogram whose top edge subtly suggests a three-point crown using elegant negative space. Strong compact silhouette, sophisticated rather than regal ornament. Orange standalone icon on the left; confident slightly wide geometric sans KINGAI wordmark on the right. Crown should emerge from the K construction, not float above it. Premium, clear at tiny favicon size.

selected_refinement: Edit this product logo. Preserve the warm ivory rounded-square backplate, thin neutral border, orange #EF6938 text, lowercase "king" on the first line, uppercase "AI" on the second line, centered stacked arrangement. ONLY change the typography sizing: both lines must use EXACTLY THE SAME FONT SIZE AND FONT WEIGHT. The glyphs A and I use the same font scale as k, i, n, g. Do NOT enlarge AI, do NOT stretch AI, do NOT match line widths. The AI line must naturally be much narrower than the king line (roughly half as wide), centered underneath it. Overall wordmark centered vertically and horizontally on the tile, comfortable gap between lines and generous margins. Keep lowercase king / uppercase AI exactly. No crown or independent K mark, no extra text. Clean flat vector-like finish, no gradients or texture. Transparent outside the original rounded-square backplate. This is the final logo, no presentation board.
